# Getting Support for msgp2p

We are thrilled you are using `msgp2p`! To ensure that questions receive quick assistance while keeping our issue tracker dedicated to actionable software defects, please use the appropriate channel below.

---

## 1. Documentation & Architecture References

Before opening an inquiry, check our extensive technical documentation:

* **[README.md](../README.md)**: Project overview, prerequisites, and quick-start guides.
* **[architecture.md](../architecture.md)**: Architectural deep-dive, version vector design, storage models, and transport layers.
* **[protocol/wire-format.md](../protocol/wire-format.md)**: Formal CDDL wire format, framing, and cryptographic envelope specifications.
* **[requirements.md](../requirements.md)**: Traceable functional and non-functional requirement definitions.
* **[protocol/openapi.yaml](../protocol/openapi.yaml)**: Complete REST API specification for gateway servers.

---

## 2. Community Q&A and Discussions

For general inquiries, advice on hardware modules, architecture discussions, or assistance integrating `msgp2p` into your mobile app, please visit:

👉 **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ESSENTIELLEMENT/msgp2p/discussions)**

Discussions categories include:
* **Q&A**: Ask how to configure transports, set up servers, or integrate with Flutter UI widgets.
* **Ideas**: Discuss potential roadmap items, radio enhancements, or protocol optimizations.
* **Show and Tell**: Share mobile applications or deployments you've built using `msgp2p`.

---

## 3. Bug Reports & Defect Tracking

If you have confirmed a bug or unexpected behavior in the SDK:
1. Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/ESSENTIELLEMENT/msgp2p/issues) to avoid duplicate reports.
2. File a detailed report using our structured **[Bug Report Form](https://github.com/ESSENTIELLEMENT/msgp2p/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**.
3. Include device models, OS versions, reproduction steps, and relevant log traces.

---

## 4. Security Vulnerabilities

To report sensitive security, cryptographic, or privacy vulnerabilities, do not use public issues or discussions. Instead, follow our **[Security Policy](SECURITY.md)** and file a private disclosure via [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/ESSENTIELLEMENT/msgp2p/security/advisories/new) or email `msgp2p_admin@msgp2p.squares.net`.
